scientific_limits: Fixed observed predictor medians used as simulation truths; no targeting/classification/selection simulator.
Gaussianized published percentile errors; missing Lph-T and cross-study covariances remain zero assumptions.
Main E has N=5, below the preregistered N>=20 gate regardless of simulated tails.
Curtis A own-Halpha is13-source matched subset; the full18-source BX-Lbol diagnostic is not used as a proxy for own Halpha.
A and B overlap and are not independent evidence.
